meta.name: Fino corrections
meta.purpose: Every correction made to a published Fino page after it was published, so a reader can see what changed and why. The Fino connector's corrections() tool returns this list unchanged.
meta.status: No corrections have been published yet. An empty list does not mean there are no errors; it means none has been recorded here.

fields.fino_id: Decision number the correction concerns (YEAR/CC/NNN), or null if it concerns another page
fields.page_url: Public address of the corrected page
fields.what_was_wrong: The wrong statement, as it stood
fields.evidence_url: Where the right fact comes from (the regulator's original or an official text)
fields.reported_by: 'reader' or 'Fino check'. Readers are named only if they agree
fields.credit: Name of the reader, only with their agreement, otherwise null
